verdict.rationale: Gemini in Gmail is documented to summarize long threads and to act on multiple emails on request (deleting or labeling), so an assistant does operate over mail content. However, nothing shows it answering free-form questions across the whole inbox, covering the calendar, or citing sources for its answers. Missing for 10: cross-inbox Q&A (who said what, what's outstanding), calendar coverage, grounded or cited answers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
